Andy's second attempt was completely different. He restructured his entire approach, implementing convolutional layers, pooling layers, and finally fully connected layers for classification.

The results were remarkable. Andy's second CNN model achieved 94% accuracy on the same dataset that had defeated his earlier attempt. This experience taught Andy something valuable beyond technical skills. His initial failure wasn't a dead end but a necessary second step toward mastery.
